# Colors

Primary is **Black**; secondary is **Purple**. Always consume tokens (CSS variables,
the Tailwind preset, or `tokens.js`) — never hard-code hex values.

## Danger ramp

The one functional hue — reserved for errors and validation, never for brand or
decoration. Anchored on **`600 = #C11717`**.

<div class="ds-swatches">
  <div class="ds-swatch"><div class="ds-swatch__chip" style="background:#DB2121"></div><div class="ds-swatch__meta"><div class="ds-swatch__name">danger.500</div><div class="ds-swatch__hex">#DB2121</div></div></div>
  <div class="ds-swatch"><div class="ds-swatch__chip" style="background:#C11717"></div><div class="ds-swatch__meta"><div class="ds-swatch__name">danger.600</div><div class="ds-swatch__hex">#C11717</div></div></div>
</div>

## Coin

A single gold accent for coin / currency icons and amounts — not a brand or UI
colour, use it only for coin denominations.

<div class="ds-swatches">
  <div class="ds-swatch"><div class="ds-swatch__chip" style="background:#FDC700"></div><div class="ds-swatch__meta"><div class="ds-swatch__name">Coin</div><div class="ds-swatch__hex">color.coin · #FDC700</div></div></div>
</div>

## Semantic tokens

Consume these in components rather than raw ramp values:

| Token | Reference |
| --- | --- |
| `text.primary` / `text.accent` | black / purple.600 |
| `text.subtle` / `text.disabled` / `text.danger` | black 65% / neutral.400 / danger.600 |
| `bg.subtle` | purple.50 |
| `border.accent` / `border.invalid` | purple.600 / danger.600 |
| `input.bg` / `input.border-focus` / `input.border-invalid` | black 5% (#0000000D) / purple.600 / danger.600 |
| `input.label` / `input.required` | black / danger.500 |
| `focus.ring` | purple.600 |
